name: Golden Light
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: A luminous floral amber that captures the warmth of golden light.
longDescription: Golden Light opens with a burst of sparkling bergamot and pink pepper before revealing a heart of ylang-ylang and jasmine sambac. The dry-down is an exquisite weave of warm amber, sandalwood, and a whisper of vanilla — lingering on skin like the last rays of a summer afternoon.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Coumarin, Citronellol, Geraniol, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate

name: White Sand
subtitle: Eau de Toilette
description: White sand beaches and sun-warmed skin. A summer reverie.
longDescription: White Sand evokes the sensation of bare feet on warm white sand. Notes of coconut water and neroli open freshly before a heart of tuberose and sea salt develops. A base of driftwood and ambrette seeds leaves an effortlessly sensual trail that lingers through golden hours.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Citronellol, Benzyl Salicylate, Hydroxycitronellal

name: Velvet Night
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Velvet darkness and winter spice. A fragrance for the night.
longDescription: Velvet Night is a winter nocturne — rich, complex, and deeply sensual. Cardamom and black pepper open with authority, giving way to a heart of oud absolute and Bulgarian rose. The finish of labdanum, benzoin, and dark patchouli creates a velvety skin scent that lasts from dusk to dawn.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Eugenol, Isoeugenol, Coumarin, Farnesol, Cinnamal

name: Rose Absolute
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: The purest expression of rose. Timeless, feminine, absolute.
longDescription: Rose Absolute is a love letter to the queen of flowers. Drawing from three distinct rose varieties — Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose otto, and rose absolute — this fragrance captures every facet of rose: dewy and green at first, lush and honeyed at heart, then warm and intimate as it dries down over cashmere wood and musk.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Citronellol, Geraniol, Linalool, Farnesol, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate

name: Sacred Wood
subtitle: Eau de Parfum Intense
description: Ancient woods and sacred resins. A meditation in fragrance.
longDescription: Sacred Wood is inspired by the stillness of ancient forests and the smoke of sacred rituals. Frankincense and elemi open with an almost edible quality before the heart reveals aged cedarwood and gaïac wood. A deep base of castoreum, leather, and oakmoss creates an extraordinary silage — profound, timeless, and utterly unforgettable.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Coumarin, Atranol, Chloroatranol, Farnesol

name: Sea Salt
subtitle: Eau de Cologne
description: Ocean breeze and sea spray. The freedom of open water.
longDescription: Sea Salt captures the exhilarating rush of sea air. An opening of ozone and cold sea spray gives way to aromatic marine lavender and driftwood heart. The skin-close dry down of mineral musks and salted woods makes this the ideal fragrance for warm days when you need to feel alive.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Citronellol, Coumarin, Geraniol

name: Pure Amber
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Warm amber and golden spice. Pure liquid comfort.
longDescription: Pure Amber is a masterclass in warmth. Opening with a hint of cardamom and clove, the fragrance quickly settles into a glowing heart of labdanum absolute and sweet orange blossom. The lingering base of benzoin, vanilla absolute, and tonka bean makes this the most comforting scent in our collection — a warm embrace in a bottle.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Coumarin, Eugenol, Limonene, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Benzoate

name: Cotton Flower
subtitle: Eau de Toilette
description: Clean cotton and fresh air. Effortless, everyday elegance.
longDescription: Cotton Flower evokes the simple pleasure of freshly laundered linen drying in a gentle breeze. White musk and clean aldehydes open crisply, supported by a delicate heart of iris, white peony, and soft violet leaf. The base is pure comfort — warm skin musk and a whisper of cedarwood.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Citronellol, Geraniol, Benzyl Alcohol

name: Royal Incense
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Royal incense and ancient myrrh. Majestic and enduring.
longDescription: Royal Incense is a tribute to the ancient art of incense burning. Ethiopian frankincense and Omani myrrh dominate the opening, creating a cloud of sacred smoke. Rose and orris appear in the heart, lending feminine complexity. The base of cistus, oud wood, and dark amber ensures an extraordinary presence on the skin for hours.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Farnesol, Coumarin, Eugenol, Cinnamal, Limonene

name: Secret Garden
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: A hidden garden in full bloom. Green, alive, and fleeting.
longDescription: Step through an old wooden gate into Secret Garden — a private garden where everything is in bloom at once. Tomato leaf and green violet open with a startling freshness before a lush heart of rose, peony, and sweet pea emerges. The base of wet earth and soft woods captures the garden at dusk, after rain.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Citronellol, Geraniol, Farnesol, Hydroxycitronellal

name: Cedar & Iris
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Powdery iris and atlas cedar. Architectural, precise, elegant.
longDescription: Cedar & Iris is an exercise in elegant restraint. The opening is a clean, slightly powdery iris absolute — almost violet, almost root — that deepens over time into a heart of heliotrope and orris butter. Atlas cedarwood and amyris in the base provide a warm, slightly creamy structure that supports the iris without overwhelming it.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Coumarin, Citronellol, Geraniol

name: Golden Petal
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Golden petals and honey. The sweetest luxury.
longDescription: Golden Petal is an ode to the sensuality of flowers steeped in golden honey. Opening with a champagne-like fizz of peach and osmanthus, the fragrance unfolds into a heart of mimosa absolute and honeyed rose. The base of beeswax, sandalwood, and cashmere creates an extraordinarily skin-like warmth.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Farnesol, Benzyl Benzoate, Linalool, Citronellol, Geraniol, Eugenol

name: Aqua Light
subtitle: Eau de Cologne
description: Light on water. An instant feeling of clarity and calm.
longDescription: Aqua Light is the lightest fragrance in our collection — a luminous splash of citrus and aquatic notes that lifts the spirits immediately. Sicilian lemon and grapefruit sparkle over a fresh heart of water lily and green tea. The dry down of white woods and mineral musks is clean, bright, and effortlessly wearable.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Limonene, Linalool, Citronellol, Benzyl Salicylate, Coumarin

name: Royal Oud
subtitle: Extrait de Parfum
description: Our most prestigious creation. Rare oud and imperial gold.
longDescription: Royal Oud represents the pinnacle of our craft. Built around a rare Cambodian oud absolute of extraordinary quality, this extrait opens with a burst of saffron and rose before the oud unfolds in all its complexity — dark, leathery, and slightly sweet. Aged sandalwood, pure labdanum, and a whisper of smoke complete this imperial statement.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Farnesol, Linalool, Eugenol, Coumarin, Isoeugenol, Cinnamal

name: Celestial Musk
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Clean, celestial, close to skin. The scent of pure grace.
longDescription: Celestial Musk is an exploration of the musk family — not the heavy, animalic musks of old, but the clean, ethereal musks discovered in the last decades of perfumery. Bright ambrette seed and airy cashmeran open over a transparent heart of Clearwood and white musk before settling into a barely-there skin scent that enhances rather than covers.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Citronellol, Coumarin, Benzyl Salicylate

name: Summer Duo
subtitle: Gift Set — 2 × 30ml
description: White Sand and Aqua Light together. The summer duo.
longDescription: The Summer Duo pairs our two defining summer fragrances in a beautifully presented gift set. White Sand for evenings — warmer, more sensual. Aqua Light for mornings — bright and invigorating. Together they capture the full spectrum of summer light, from the first cool hour to the last warm breath of the day.
ingredients: See individual fragrances

name: Winter Collection
subtitle: Gift Set — 3 × 30ml
description: Three winter masterpieces. The complete cold-weather collection.
longDescription: The Winter Collection brings together our three most acclaimed winter fragrances — Velvet Night, Royal Incense, and Sacred Wood — in an exquisite presentation box. Each bottle is 30ml, perfect for alternating through the winter season according to occasion and mood. An ideal gift for those who understand true luxury.

heart: Velvet Night + Royal Incense + Sacred Wood

ingredients: See individual fragrances

name: Citrus & Vetiver
subtitle: Eau de Toilette
description: The classic gentleman's summer. Bright citrus, grounded vetiver.
longDescription: Citrus & Vetiver is the quintessential warm-weather fragrance for those who prefer their elegance understated. A vivid opening of lime, grapefruit, and neroli gives way to a refined heart of petit grain and rosemary before Haitian vetiver — earthy, smoky, slightly green — grounds the composition with remarkable authority.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Limonene, Linalool, Citronellol, Geraniol, Coumarin

name: Dark Vanilla
subtitle: Eau de Parfum
description: Dark vanilla and smoked wood. Seductive. Mysterious. Memorable.
longDescription: Dark Vanilla turns the familiar comfort of vanilla on its head. Where most vanillas are sweet and simple, this one is complex and slightly dark. Opening with smoked rum and black cardamom, the fragrance reveals its warm vanilla heart only gradually — Tahitian vanilla absolute bolstered by dark benzoin and guaiac wood. The result is hypnotic.
ingredients: Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Coumarin, Linalool, Benzyl Benzoate, Farnesol, Eugenol, Cinnamal

name: Signature Set
subtitle: Prestige Set — 5 × 15ml
description: Five icons. One prestige set. The definitive WAQAR experience.
longDescription: The Signature Set is our most prestigious offering — five of WAQAR's most iconic fragrances, each in a 15ml travel flacon presented in a handmade lacquered box. Includes: Golden Light, Rose Absolute, Pure Amber, Sacred Wood, and Royal Oud. A statement gift. An invitation to explore.
